plate_comment: Sends the next data packet (TP.DT) of broadcast (BAM) session record param_1 (0 = j1939_source_address / 1 = j1939_engine_retarder_source_address) once its packet delay timer reaches 0: the packet number plus up to 7 data bytes from the record's advancing data pointer. The last packet ends the session. The message status becomes 0x11 while the session runs / 5 after the last packet / the send result if the frame fails. The delay is 5 service passes / 0 while j1939_broadcast_no_packet_delay_flag is set (was j1939_transport_singleFrame_send; PR #53 round 34) (was j1939_transport_singleFrame_send)

Sends the data packets (TP.DT) that the last clear to send granted the connection mode (RTS / CTS) transmit session: up to 10 per call / status 0x13 after each. Then it waits up to 0x70 passes for the next clear to send. With no window granted it counts the timeout down and ends the session with status 6 at 0 / a frame that fails to send ends it with status 7 (was j1939_transport_dataFrame_bulkSend; PR #53 round 34) (was j1939_transport_dataFrame_bulkSend)

The application J1939 transport's periodic service: sends the next packet of each active broadcast session record (cm848_sendJ1939BroadcastDataPacket 0 / 1) / runs the connection mode transmit session (cm848_sendJ1939ConnectionModeDataPackets) / ages the receive session's timeout (j1939_transport_timeout_decrement) (was phase_group_a_triggerControllerUpdates; PR #53 round 34) (was phase_group_a_triggerControllerUpdates)

Points the transport's frame buffers (the two broadcast session records' at 0x3fbdb4 / 0x3fbdbc / the connection mode transmit session's at 0x3fbde7 / the receive data buffer at 0x3fbe09) and registers the PGN 60416 (TP.CM) and 60160 (TP.DT) receive handlers j1939_transport_dispatchConnectionManagement / j1939_transport_handleDataPacket (was j1939_pgn_handler_init_ec00eb00; PR #53 round 34) (was j1939_pgn_handler_init_ec00eb00)
